name: Stopwatch laps
oneLiner: a glass stopwatch dial turns toward camera, its accent hand whips round with a motion trail while the readout races, each lap press pulses the dial and drops a lap row onto the stack, then the hand brakes on a long tail and the final time stamps with a ring of light
say: when the speaker says how long something took ('it did it in under five minutes', 'each step took a minute'): the laps drop on each step, the time stamps on the number
